# E12b tables (generated by collect.py)

chr1 (and HCC1395T chr20), in the benchmark BED, after the PoN. SNV cells: P / R / **F1** at the PASS threshold (each model's own validation recall-0.9 threshold). INDEL cells: **best F1** of the chr1 curve (upper bound) (PASS F1). In-sample = the single-tumor HPRC v2.1 model of that tumor; cross-tumor = the single-tumor model of the other tumor (E12a; HCC1395T: HG008T model / COLO829T model). Multi-cancer models: re-predictions with the --norm dataset fix (f344bca). Comparators: PASS after the same PoN (INDEL: best F1 of the all-records curve after the PoN (PASS F1)); DeepSomatic's models were trained on HCC1395 with chr1 held out, ClairS-TO's never saw HCC1395.
